The target axes show the attained gripper frame. Each pose passed joint limits, pose tolerances, an unloaded 5 mm static balance screen and an endpoint mesh-intersection check. Replanted poses assume the feet have already reached the new locations. The viewer shows endpoints and simplified CAD surfaces. Physical walking, cable clearance and payload capacity still require validation.

Geometry from Open Duck Mini v2 and TheRobotStudio SO-101. Dimensions and poses are in the supplied engineering package.
